name: openexr-image-channel-num-pixels
fixed_note: ImageChannel::resize: compute the pixel count in 64 bits with an overflow check
setup: mkdir -p build-raptor/cfg && for f in cmake/*Config*.h.in; do sed -e "s/^#cmakedefine \([A-Za-z_0-9]*\).*/\/* #undef \1 *\//" -e "s/@OPENEXR_INTERNAL_IMF_NAMESPACE@/Imf_3_4/" -e "s/@OPENEXR_IMF_NAMESPACE@/Imf/" -e "s/@IEX_INTERNAL_NAMESPACE@/Iex_3_4/" -e "s/@IEX_NAMESPACE@/Iex/" -e "s/@ILMTHREAD_INTERNAL_NAMESPACE@/IlmThread_3_4/" -e "s/@ILMTHREAD_NAMESPACE@/IlmThread/" -e "s/@OPENEXR_VERSION_MAJOR@/3/" -e "s/@OPENEXR_VERSION_MINOR@/4/" -e "s/@Imath_VERSION_MAJOR@/3/" -e "s/@Imath_VERSION_MINOR@/1/" -e "s/@[A-Za-z_]*@/0/g" "$f" > "build-raptor/cfg/$(basename "$f" .in)"; done
